note: Statements about time lags or adoption speed, as stated in the sources. Not comparable with each other (they measure different things).

lags.statement: Learning platforms required decades for complete institutionalisation.
Lockdown-driven transitions to remote teaching were enforced within days; a large reported share of surveyed students shifted online; the figure remains unverified.

ChatGPT reached reported rapid global uptake within months; the figure remains unverified; universities began issuing policies within weeks, but many highly ranked universities still lacked policies by mid-2023.
Movable-type adoption in Europe, 1450-1500, was conditioned by existing technical skill clusters.
German physics gained firm university footing only by the 1840s.
Ottoman Darulfunun: stop-start development from 1845 proposals to the 1900 reform.
Postal systems: multidecade delay between technology availability and institutional uptake; illiterate poor excluded.
Heavy 1920s-1930s investment in educational radio did not secure sustained success (a negative case).
Paper diffused over multiple centuries from China and Central Asia through the Islamic world to Europe.
Open-access mandates raised deposit rates, but culture change lagged.
